description: Verbatim SPK type-2 records from JPL DE442 (1549-12-31 – 2650-01-25) and DE441 (other years), chunked by time. Positions in km, ICRF (J2000 frame id 1), argument TDB seconds past J2000.
references: Park et al. 2021, AJ 161:105 (DE440/DE441); DE442 integrated 2024-05-13 (kernel comments). Checksums: https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/spk/planets/aa_checksums.txt
redistribution: JPL/NAIF ephemeris products are publicly released; NAIF rules: https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/naif/rules.html
